title: PvP-Utilities
pos.title: Reach Display Position
pos.hint: Drag the text, arrow keys move by 1 pixel, Esc to cancel
sat.enabled: Show saturation on the food bar (golden drumsticks)
mom.enabled: Show speed in the XP bar
mom.hide: XP bar visible after XP gain (ticks)
reach.enabled.tip: Shows the distance of your last hit under the crosshair. It is always visible and shows 0.00 when you have not hit anything recently.
reach.shadow.tip: Adds a shadow behind the reach text so it stays readable on any background.
reach.background.tip: Draws a box behind the reach text.
reach.scale.tip: Size of the reach text, in percent.
reach.shadowColor.tip: Color of the shadow behind the reach text.
reach.backgroundColor.tip: Color and opacity of the box behind the reach text.
reach.unit.tip: How the distance is written: number only, with the word blocks, or with the letter m.
reach.decimals.tip: Number of digits shown after the decimal point.
reach.players.tip: Only measures hits on players and ignores mobs.
reach.keep.tip: Keeps the last distance on screen instead of going back to 0.00 after the delay.
reach.hide.tip: Seconds before the display goes back to 0.00. Ignored when the last distance is kept.
reach.edit.tip: Opens an editor where you drag the reach text anywhere on the screen, with Reset, Cancel and Apply buttons.
cross.enabled.tip: Colors the vanilla crosshair when you aim at something you can hit.
cross.players.tip: Only reacts to players and ignores mobs.
cross.charge.tip: The critical color only shows when your attack is almost fully charged.
cross.hitColor.tip: Crosshair color when you can hit the target.
cross.critColor.tip: Crosshair color when you can land a critical hit (falling, not sprinting).
sat.enabled.tip: Draws a golden outline on the food icons to show your saturation, so you see how long you stay fed.
tint.enabled.tip: Replaces the red hurt flash with your own color when a player takes damage.
tint.mode.tip: Where the color is applied: skin only, armor only (also colors the item held in hand), or both.
tint.target.tip: Which entities get the color: players only or every entity.
tint.self.tip: Also colors your own character when you take damage.
hit.enabled.tip: Customizes the hitboxes drawn by the game (colors, filters, thickness, distance).
hit.eye.tip: Shows the line at eye height.
hit.look.tip: Shows the line of the direction the entity is looking.
hit.reach.tip: Uses the in-reach color on entities you could hit from where you stand.
hit.mobs.tip: Shows the hitboxes of mobs and animals.
hit.projectiles.tip: Shows the hitboxes of arrows, pearls and other projectiles.
hit.items.tip: Shows the hitboxes of dropped items.
hit.others.tip: Shows the hitboxes of every other entity.
hit.distance.tip: Hitboxes farther than this distance, in blocks, are hidden.
color.eye.tip: Color of the eye height line.
color.look.tip: Color of the look direction line.
color.target.tip: Hitbox color of the entity under your crosshair.
color.hurt.tip: Hitbox color of an entity that was just hit.
color.reach.tip: Hitbox color of an entity that is within your reach.
mom.enabled.tip: Replaces the XP bar with a speed meter. The XP bar comes back for a moment when you gain XP.
mom.text.tip: Shows your speed as text in blocks per second, colored by speed, near the center of the screen.
mom.smooth.tip: Animates the bar smoothly instead of jumping.
mom.objective.tip: Measures your real speed whatever direction you look, instead of speed along your view direction.
mom.total.tip: Includes vertical movement (jumping, falling) in the speed.
mom.relative.tip: Scales the bar with your movement speed (Speed effects and sprinting) so thresholds stay comparable.
mom.hide.tip: Game ticks (20 per second) the XP bar stays visible after you gain XP. 0 disables it.
mom.textX.tip: Moves the speed text left or right, in pixels.
mom.textY.tip: Moves the speed text up or down, in pixels.
mom.fwd.crouch.tip: Forward speed in blocks per second that counts as crouching.
mom.fwd.walk.tip: Forward speed in blocks per second that counts as walking.
mom.fwd.sprint.tip: Forward speed in blocks per second that counts as sprinting.
mom.fwd.max.tip: Forward speed in blocks per second where the second bar is full.
mom.bwd.crouch.tip: Backward speed in blocks per second that counts as crouching.
mom.bwd.walk.tip: Backward speed in blocks per second that counts as walking.
mom.bwd.sprint.tip: Backward speed in blocks per second that counts as sprinting.
mom.bwd.max.tip: Backward speed in blocks per second where the second bar is full.
bright.enabled.tip: Lights everything up as if it were bright by giving you a client-side night vision effect. It is removed when you turn it off.
lang.tip: Language of the mod menus: automatic follows the game language.
swing.enabled.tip: Replaces the sword swing with a motion that only lowers and raises the item, without going forward. First person only.
swing.depth.tip: How far the item goes down during the swing, in hundredths of a block.
swing.angle.tip: Tilt of the item during the swing, in degrees. Use a negative value to tilt the other way.
tint.opacity.tip: Strength of the damage color from 0 (invisible) to 255 (fully solid).
cat.name: Nametag tweaks
name.f1.stands: Hide armor stand nametags in F1
totem.enabled.tip: Shows a green -N next to a player name each time they pop a totem. It resets when the player dies.
totem.side.tip: Shows the totem count on the left or on the right of the player name.
tab.enabled.tip: Turns all tab list tweaks on or off.
tab.max.tip: Maximum number of players shown in the tab list. The game normally stops at 80.
tab.header.tip: Hides the text the server shows above the player list.
tab.footer.tip: Hides the text the server shows below the player list.
tab.scale.tip: Size of the tab list, in percent.
tab.x.tip: Moves the tab list left or right, in pixels.
tab.y.tip: Moves the tab list up or down, in pixels.
board.enabled.tip: Shows or hides the sidebar scoreboard.
board.scale.tip: Size of the scoreboard, in percent.
board.x.tip: Moves the scoreboard left or right, in pixels.
board.y.tip: Moves the scoreboard up or down, in pixels.
name.enabled.tip: Turns all nametag tweaks on or off.
name.own.tip: Shows your own nametag when you are in third person.
name.f1.entities.tip: Hides the nametags of mobs and other entities when the HUD is hidden with F1.
name.f1.players.tip: Hides the nametags of players when the HUD is hidden with F1.
name.f1.stands.tip: Hides the nametags of armor stands when the HUD is hidden with F1.
name.height.tip: Moves nametags up or down, in hundredths of a block.
name.scale.tip: Size of the nametags, in percent.
time.enabled.tip: Forces the time of day on your screen only. The server and other players are not affected.
time.preset.tip: Time of day shown on your screen. You can also use /time day, noon, sunset, night, midnight, moon, sunrise or reset.
weather.enabled.tip: Forces the weather on your screen only. The server and other players are not affected.
weather.type.tip: Weather shown on your screen. You can also use /weather clear, rain, storm or reset.
hudscale.enabled.tip: Turns all the sizes below on or off. Each element has its own size.
scale.hotbar.tip: Size of this element from 0 (hidden) to 3. 1.00 is the normal size and you can use decimals like 2.67.
scale.actionbar.tip: Size of this element from 0 (hidden) to 3. 1.00 is the normal size and you can use decimals like 2.67.
scale.crosshair.tip: Size of this element from 0 (hidden) to 3. 1.00 is the normal size and you can use decimals like 2.67.
scale.health.tip: Size of this element from 0 (hidden) to 3. 1.00 is the normal size and you can use decimals like 2.67.
scale.armor.tip: Size of this element from 0 (hidden) to 3. 1.00 is the normal size and you can use decimals like 2.67.
scale.food.tip: Size of this element from 0 (hidden) to 3. 1.00 is the normal size and you can use decimals like 2.67.
scale.air.tip: Size of this element from 0 (hidden) to 3. 1.00 is the normal size and you can use decimals like 2.67.
scale.xpbar.tip: Size of this element from 0 (hidden) to 3. 1.00 is the normal size and you can use decimals like 2.67.
scale.xplevel.tip: Size of this element from 0 (hidden) to 3. 1.00 is the normal size and you can use decimals like 2.67.
scale.item.tip: Size of this element from 0 (hidden) to 3. 1.00 is the normal size and you can use decimals like 2.67.
scale.effects.tip: Size of this element from 0 (hidden) to 3. 1.00 is the normal size and you can use decimals like 2.67.
scale.boss.tip: Size of this element from 0 (hidden) to 3. 1.00 is the normal size and you can use decimals like 2.67.
scale.title: Title and subtitle scale
scale.title.tip: Size of this element from 0 (hidden) to 3. 1.00 is the normal size and you can use decimals like 2.67.
scale.inventory.tip: Size of this screen from 0.25 to 3 times your normal GUI size. Minecraft only allows whole sizes for screens, so the result is rounded.
scale.pause.tip: Size of this screen from 0.25 to 3 times your normal GUI size. Minecraft only allows whole sizes for screens, so the result is rounded.
scale.settings.tip: Size of this screen from 0.25 to 3 times your normal GUI size. Minecraft only allows whole sizes for screens, so the result is rounded.
